estimators.ratio: Expanse paired scaling ratio per variant; ablation-bytes-serial-writers: C_default(W) / C_variant(W), the default build over an inverse ablation that restores the replaced path
estimators.columns: per-arm columns are medians of the same rounds; the ratio column is not the quotient of the two median columns beside it
estimators.raw: every cell carries rounds_raw, the per-round samples verbatim

provenance.cell_schedule: one harness process per timed (build, W, round) cell; within round r the 2 x len(W) (build, W) cells follow row r of a Williams design over those cells, indexed (default, W1), (variant, W1), (default, W2), ... (position = index in that row); the counters passes time nothing and run every cell of an arm in one process per build

g1_scaling.statistic: C_head(W, r) / C_serial(W, r) per round, C_b(W, r) = writer_mops(b, W, r) / writer_mops(b, 1, r); BCa 95% over the round series; PASS iff lower bound > 1.0

g2_level.statistic: writer_mops(head, W, r) / max over W' in {1, 2, 4, 8} of writer_mops(serial, W', r), per round; BCa 95%; PASS iff the lower bound is strictly above 1.0

g3_price.statistic: writer_mops(head, 1, r) / writer_mops(serial, 1, r), per round; BCa 95%; PASS iff the lower bound is at least the locked floor

g4_overwrite_skew.statistic: writer_mops(head, overwrite, zipfian, W, r) / writer_mops(head, overwrite, uniform, W, r), per round; BCa 95%; PASS iff the lower bound is at least the floor
g4_overwrite_skew.schedule: per round, a second Williams block over the six (key_dist, W) cells, head build, one process per cell; the block order within a round alternates by round

peak_ratio.statistic: writer_mops(head, 8, r) / writer_mops(head, 4, r), per round; BCa 95%

fallback_prediction.tripwire: zero lock_restarts in the single-writer (W = 1) counters rows; multi-writer restarts are reported per cell and void nothing

gate_929_bytes.note: one artifact is one (pin, run) and carries ten cells: G1, G2 and G4 at W in {2, 4, 8}, and G3. The gate is met at a head only when all forty cells over two pins and two runs PASS (METHODOLOGY.md §22.4); the peak ratio is reported and gates nothing.
